scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && cd server && go mod tidy
scripts.dev:browser: concurrently -k -n FRONTEND,SERVER -c yellow,cyan "npm --prefix frontend run dev:frontend" "cd server && cross-env CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173 go run ./cmd/server"
scripts.dev: npm run tauri:check && npm run build:backend && npm run prepare:sidecar && tauri dev
scripts.build: npm run tauri:check && npm run build:backend && npm run prepare:sidecar && tauri build
scripts.lint: npm --prefix frontend run lint && cd server && go test ./...
